test_case_name: Navigate to Governance Section from Main Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link on the main menu
And then check that the 'Governance: documenti e informazioni - Intesa Sanpaolo' page is displayed

test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the 'ACCONSENTO' link on the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed on the Governance page

test_case_name: Reject Cookies and View More Options on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link on the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie policy options page is displayed

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'js-cookie-banner-close' to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Use Accessibility Skip to Content on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Contenuto' button to skip to main content
And then check that the focus is moved to the main content section

test_case_name: Use Accessibility Skip to Menu on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Menù' button to skip to the menu
And then check that the focus is moved to the main menu section

test_case_name: Use Accessibility Skip to Footer on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Piè di pagina' button to skip to the footer
And then check that the focus is moved to the footer section

test_case_name: Perform a Search on Governance Page

intents.intent: Click the header search open button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search'
Type $name into the input with placeholder 'Cerca'
Click the search submit button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button'
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name
